name: openclaw_health
description: Check OpenClaw gateway health and connectivity

name: openclaw_list_agents
description: List all configured OpenClaw agents and related model aliases

name: openclaw_get_status
description: Get detailed status of a gateway, agent, task, or project

target.description: Agent name, task ID, project name, or 'gateway'

name: openclaw_get_summary
description: Get a concise operational summary across agents/tasks

target.description: Optional focus area (agent, project, or omit for all)

name: openclaw_assign_task
description: Assign a new task to an OpenClaw agent or the orchestrator. Requires confirmed=true after explicit user confirmation.

agent.description: Optional agent id/name. Defaults to orchestrator/main.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirms

name: openclaw_control_session
description: Start, pause, resume, or stop an agent/task session. Requires confirmed=true after explicit user confirmation.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirms
